scope: Preserve ORS waycategory motorway coloring: motorway/motorway_link sections orange and ordinary sections blue.
Make route state explicit with 高速区間あり/なし and 有料道路回避中/使用可 so an all-blue route is understandable.

MAP may rotate to landscape and has an app-managed fullscreen mode; native Fullscreen and landscape orientation lock are opportunistic enhancements.
Analytics engine, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits, route vehicle settings and user data remain preserved.
